pages.name: Eagle
pages.text: Eagles soar high over sunlit mountain ridges: Stony, Jagged, and Frozen Peaks, Snowy Slopes, and Windswept Hills. Rare, proud, and worth the climb.

Tame an eagle with raw rabbit or fish and it keeps you company: circling overhead while you travel, landing on a lookout nearby when you stop, and flying as your wingman on an elytra.$(br2)An $(l)Eagle Whistle$() cycles its orders (fetch, guard) and, sneaking, recalls it to land beside you. Bind it to an $(l)Eagle Perch$() and it glides home to wait while you're away.

pages.title: The Stoop
pages.text: Mark a mob by watching it through a $(l)spyglass$() for three seconds. Your eagle climbs high above it and dives: each strike does a little damage and leaves the target $(l)glowing$(), then it climbs and dives again. It softens and spots; the kill is yours.$(br2)Wild eagles hunt rabbits and fish for themselves.

pages.title: A Wild Life
pages.text: Eagles fly in daylight and roost at night, head tucked, on their nest or a high lookout; storms send them under the trees. Over steep slopes they ride the updraft.$(br2)Wild eagles carry their kills home to feed their eaglets, and defend a nest with young: a few warning dives, then the real thing.

pages.title: On Guard
pages.text: A guarding eagle stoops on any mob that hurts you; it never turns on players or your other pets.$(br2)Idle near water, a tame eagle sometimes goes fishing and brings you its catch.

pages.title: Care
pages.text: Feed a hurt eagle rabbit or fish to heal it. Below a third of its health it can't fly: it limps on the ground, wing hanging, until you do.$(br2)Tame eagles moult a $(l)brown feather$() every few minutes. Hit in flight, an eagle drops whatever it was carrying.$(br2)Tired of the feathers? Rub $(l)honeycomb$() into them and it stops moulting, until rain or a swim washes the wax out.
Eagles nest, breed, and raise eaglets. Find a wild $(l)nest$() on a high ridge, or build your own with an $(l)Eagle Nest$() and an $(l)Eagle Egg$() to start your own line of birds.
